seo.title: Work With Me
seo.description: Six ways to work with Dr. Lauretta Ogbum — individual and couples therapy, premarital work, the Annual Review, Intensives and Diaspora sessions. Fees shown in ₦, £ or $.

hero.title: Every piece of work here starts the same way.
hero.intro: A free fifteen-minute conversation. There is no charge, no obligation, and nothing goes on record. You describe what is happening; I tell you honestly which of these — if any — is the right one.

fees.title: Side by side
fees.tableCaption: Comparison of services, who each is for, session length and fee

rows.who: Crisis, or no time for weekly

fees.note: Block and programme rates carry a saving on the per-session fee — see each service page for the full breakdown. A limited number of reduced-fee places are held at any time; if cost is the only thing in the way, say so in your first conversation.

process.title: Four steps, and you can stop at any of them
process.intro: Nothing here is a commitment you cannot withdraw from.

closing.title: Not sure which one?
closing.intro: Most people aren’t. That is what the free conversation is for — and if you would rather look at it privately first, either assessment will tell you a great deal in ten minutes.
